changePermissions.title: Let automation change agent permissions
changePermissions.description: Lets tools connected to Orchester widen what agents may do: write access, network, commands, MCP servers, approving automatically, new CLI programs and environment variables. Only you can change this, here in the window.
changePermissions.blocked: A change brought by an MCP client's input was not taken: only you turn this on, here in the window.
